outline:
學生與教授討論擬定之研究題目,在教授個別指導下,進行實驗之研究,以培養學生尋找相關資料,文獻及獨立研究的訓練,並將其研究成果撰寫成報告並公開發表練習。
To make students able to carry out independent study.  Students will be assigned a short topic.  An independent experimental design, data analysis, and final report presentation are necessary for this course.
schedule:
前 8 週 - 文獻閱讀 + exp。
第 9 週——給教授的簡報。
第 10-17 週- exp。
第 18 週 - 最終報告。the first 8 week- literature reading + exp.
the 9th week- briefing to professor.
the 10th- 17 th week- exp.
the 18th week- final report.
assessment:
文獻閱讀，經驗，最終報告。
分別為 30%、30%、40%。
literature reading,  exp,  final report.
30%, 30%, 40%, respectively.
